title: 1801 Prairie's round corner bay, from its 1965 photograph
items: The W. W. Kimball house at 1801 Prairie now turns its south-west corner in a two-storey round bay, one window a storey under a pierced stone balcony, as Harold Allen's 1965 HABS photograph shows it.
The gabled pavilion beside it is narrower, its paired windows and carved gable centred on its face.
